verdict.line: You lose trades levels 1-5 to Blinding Dart and poison poke, and you win once Dusk and Dawn and R come online around level 9-11.

brief.thesis: Teemo's 680-range Q and his passive on-hit poison outrange every Volibear tool that matters before level 6 (Q is 300 range, W is 325), and Blinding Dart's blind can make Q's stun-attack or W's on-hit mark whiff outright. That gap is why Teemo holds the measured lane and solo-kill edge in this matchup (44% Volibear win rate over 1,517 games) even though the champion's overall top lane win rate sits near 48.9%.

theirWindow.when: whenever his Blinding Dart (Q) is up
theirWindow.what: He will blind you the instant you commit Q or W, making the Q stun-attack or the W on-hit mark whiff, then free-hit you with Toxic Shot poison while backing off on Move Quick's passive speed. Do not commit either ability into a ready Q.

yourWindow.when: right after he throws Blinding Dart
yourWindow.what: Blinding Dart is on an 8s cooldown with no charges, so the moment it's spent he has no answer to your gap close. Walk up and land Q (Thundering Smash) for the stun, then chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice on the same target for the bonus damage and heal.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: This is the measured highest-winrate start (45.2% over 1,065 games, 56.3% pick) and the extra sustain matters here because you can't contest Teemo's poke range before level 6 — you need to survive the exchanges, not win them.

boots.why: The most-picked boots (60.5% pick, 44.1% win rate) — magic resist cuts into Toxic Shot's damage-over-time and Noxious Trap's poison cloud, both of which are magic damage ticking on you all lane.

core.why: On-hit sustain that turns your W (Frenzied Maul) stacking into healing, which is how you outlast his poke once you can actually land hits.
Cooldown refund on crit shortens your Q (Thundering Smash, 12s down to 10s at rank 5) and W (5s) loop, letting you re-engage faster than he can kite.
Heal and shield power amplifies both the W recast heal and the E (Sky Splitter) shield you get for standing in your own blast, directly countering his poison chip damage.

situational.when: he's kiting you down side lanes and you need wave clear and poke of your own to answer
the game goes long and you need extra sustain and a slow to actually catch him
fights are dragging out and you need more raw sustained damage through his kiting
the enemy team adds real mixed physical and magic damage threats beyond Teemo

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking attack speed compounds with Volibear's own passive attack speed grant, so every W mark and auto you land in a trade window hits faster and harder than the one before — critical since your trade windows against Teemo are short.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the most-run pair (59.2% pick) and lets you convert a landed Q stun into a real kill through his Move Quick escape speed. Exhaust is the alternative when you need to neutralize his kiting and poison burst directly in a forced fight rather than racing him to a kill.

playing.title: Never engage into a ready Q
playing.detail: If Blinding Dart is up, assume your Q stun or W mark will whiff. Hold your abilities and just walk the trade until he spends it.

playing.title: Punish the 8s Q cooldown window
playing.detail: The instant he throws Blinding Dart, close the distance — he has nothing else to stop your Q (Thundering Smash) gap close for 8 full seconds.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's recast on an already-marked target deals bonus damage and heals you — always go for the second cast in a trade, not a fresh mark on someone else.

playing.title: Use E to zone, not just react
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range lets you threaten damage and a slow from well outside his Toxic Shot range; throw it preemptively to punish his positioning rather than only using it mid-trade.

playing.title: Track mushroom placements near objectives
playing.detail: Noxious Trap is on a 1s cooldown, so he can carpet jungle entrances and river crossings cheaply. Ward or walk around known trap spots before dragon and herald fights.

playing.title: Save R to bypass his kite entirely
playing.detail: Stormbringer's leap ignores his Move Quick speed and disables nearby towers on landing — save it for the all-in dive rather than using it as a poke tool.

playing.title: Respect Camouflage near brush
playing.detail: If he's stood still and vanished, expect an ambush auto with Element of Surprise attack speed right after. Don't walk into unwarded brush on low health.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) — the ability mechanics and the tactical reasoning connecting them to those numbers are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Teemo during early game by keeping your distance. Avoid using [Q][W] while you are blinded by (Q).
